provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Clothing Brand

examples.psychological_goal: 用第二人称邀约把观众直接设为当事人
examples.expression_mechanism: 创业邀约式直接称呼（So, you want to start X）
examples.example_text: So, you want to start a clothing brand.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句'你想做X'代替任何主题介绍，瞬间锁定目标观众
examples.negative_instruction: X 必须是观众真实的向往；不要用观众无感的生意

examples.psychological_goal: 用一组诱人数字建立纸面幻觉，为戳破蓄势
examples.expression_mechanism: 诱人数学（成本vs售价对照）
examples.example_text: A shirt that cost you $12 to make, you sell for 60.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给出观众最想信的数字，让后面的反转更有力
examples.negative_instruction: 数字必须真实有出处；幻觉是为戳破而建，不可当成卖点

examples.psychological_goal: 在承认数字真实之后立刻剥夺其意义
examples.expression_mechanism: 先扬后抑（real but useless）+ 衡量对象重定义
examples.example_text: It is also almost completely useless because it is measuring the wrong thing.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先承认对方数字的真实性，再指出它衡量错了对象
examples.negative_instruction: 否定必须落在'衡量对象'上而非数字本身，保持严谨

examples.psychological_goal: 把悖论压缩成一个驱动全片的核心问题
examples.expression_mechanism: 如果X为什么Y式设问
examples.example_text: If the markup on clothing is this generous, why do most new fashion brands go bankrupt within 3 years of launching?
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'如果X成立，为什么Y发生'的悖论设问作为全片引擎
examples.negative_instruction: 问题中的两个事实都必须可查证，不可制造假悖论

examples.psychological_goal: 用三连同构对比宣判'纸面数字不决定命运'
examples.expression_mechanism: Same A, same B, wildly different C 排比
examples.example_text: Same industry, same margins on paper, wildly different outcomes.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用两个same加一个wildly different的排比压缩对比案例
examples.negative_instruction: 对比双方必须在关键变量上真的同构，否则是假对照

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众的默认算法直接命名为虚构
examples.expression_mechanism: 错误定义复述 + 两词宣判（is fiction）
examples.example_text: they call that the profit. That number is fiction.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先复述观众的算法再一刀切命名其为虚构
examples.negative_instruction: 宣判后必须立即给出'真实版本'，不可只破不立

examples.psychological_goal: 用拟人化冷笑话开启物流成本层
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定式拟人幽默（doesn't teleport）
examples.example_text: hoodie doesn't teleport from the factory floor to your customer's doorstep.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一个'它不会瞬移'式的废话冷笑话软化密集数字段落
examples.negative_instruction: 幽默服务于引出成本层，一句即止，不要发展成段子

examples.psychological_goal: 把全部成本层叠压缩成一句累加宣判
examples.expression_mechanism: 累加宣判（Add it all together, X has quietly become Y）
examples.example_text: Add it all together, and that $12 hoodie has quietly become a $30 to $40 hoodie.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在长列举后用'加起来'一句完成数字塌方
examples.negative_instruction: 累加结果必须由前文每层数字支撑，不可跳步

examples.psychological_goal: 用'你以为赢了的那单其实在亏'制造财务扎心时刻
examples.expression_mechanism: 期望反转（the sale that was supposed to be your win）
examples.example_text: you didn't make $25. you lost $20 on the sale that was supposed to be your win.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把亏损定位在'本该是胜利的地方'放大冲击
examples.negative_instruction: 演算的三个数字必须先交代，反转才有力量

examples.psychological_goal: 预告一个反直觉机制，先承认它听起来疯
examples.expression_mechanism: 反直觉预告（sounds insane until you see the mechanism）
examples.example_text: Here's the part that sounds insane until you see the mechanism behind it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在抛出反常结论前先承认其表面荒谬，换取观众耐心
examples.negative_instruction: 机制必须紧接着完整展示，不可只制造惊讶不给解释

examples.psychological_goal: 用同一笔钱的两种算法完成LTV认知翻转
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定+重算（didn't lose X. You made Y.）
examples.example_text: you didn't lose $40. You made closer to 120.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你没亏X，你赚了Y'的同额重算翻转亏损定义
examples.negative_instruction: 重算的前提条件（复购次数）必须在上下文中明示

examples.psychological_goal: 用残酷比例打碎'花钱买来的就是客户'的幻觉
examples.expression_mechanism: 残酷比例+动词收束（vanish）
examples.example_text: 70 to 80% of the people you paid so much to acquire buy exactly one time and vanish.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你花大价钱X的人，其实只Y一次就消失'的句式
examples.negative_instruction: 比例必须有行业数据支撑，注明语境

examples.psychological_goal: 用'你以为的X其实是Y'完成行业本质重命名
examples.expression_mechanism: 行业重命名（actually a Y company that happens to sell X）
examples.example_text: A founder who thinks they're starting a clothing company slowly discovers they've actually started a media company that happens to sell clothing.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你以为在开X公司，其实在开顺便卖X的Y公司'的句式
examples.negative_instruction: 重命名必须有前文证据（内容投入占比）支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用违反直觉的法律冷知识制造'这怎么可能'时刻
examples.expression_mechanism: 冷知识揭示（almost no legal protection）
examples.example_text: There is almost no legal protection for the actual design of a piece of clothing.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在观众默认有保护的领域抛出一个保护真空
examples.negative_instruction: 法律陈述必须注明法域与适用边界

examples.psychological_goal: 用'不是A而是B'替换观众心中的头号死因
examples.expression_mechanism: 死因重命名（not profit on paper, but cash flow）
examples.example_text: cash flow, not profit on paper, is the single biggest reason clothing brands actually fail.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'最大的死因不是你以为的A，是B'的句式
examples.negative_instruction: 重命名需有前文场景证据（库存危机）支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 把'增长万能'的常识彻底反转
examples.expression_mechanism: 动词替换反转（doesn't fix, finds）+ 全称强调（every single one）
examples.example_text: Growth doesn't fix weak points in a business. It finds every single one of them at the same time.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'X不会修复Y，X会同时找到所有Y'的反转句式
examples.negative_instruction: 反转后需有机制解释（规模放大系统压力）兜底

examples.psychological_goal: 用'人人稳赚vs唯独你兜底'完成风险倒置揭示
examples.expression_mechanism: 对照宣判（regardless of outcome vs only if everything works）
examples.example_text: Every other participant in this system gets paid regardless of outcome. The brand only gets paid if everything downstream of the factory works.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先把每个参与者的'旱涝保收'列完，再用一句对照落锤
examples.negative_instruction: 列举要完整（广告/支付/物流/网红/工厂），对照才成立

examples.psychological_goal: 温柔地拆开观众最不愿分开的两件事
examples.expression_mechanism: 并列拆分（X and Y are two almost unrelated skills）
examples.example_text: Loving clothes and understanding the business of clothes turn out to be two almost unrelated skills.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'X和Y其实是两种几乎无关的技能'处理观众的自我认同
examples.negative_instruction: 语气要保留善意（almost），不要变成对热爱的嘲讽

examples.psychological_goal: 用两句短句给出全片最终答案
examples.expression_mechanism: 主语替换金句（X was never the business. Y was.）
examples.example_text: The hoodie was never really the business. The audience was.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把全片论证压缩成'X从来都不是生意，Y才是'
examples.negative_instruction: 金句必须是核心问题的直接回答，不可拔高成空泛口号

examples.psychological_goal: 用'真经济学 vs 标签数字'回扣标题并封箱
examples.expression_mechanism: 标题回扣+对立（real economics, not the printed margin）
examples.example_text: That's the real economics of owning a clothing brand, not the 80% margin printed on the label.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在结尾直接念出标题并用'不是标签上的数字'完成反转
examples.negative_instruction: 回扣标题必须带着新的理解，不是简单重复
